reviewer_role: Logically separate agent: authored initial inventory, did not author density/lot-area proposals, setback proposals, height/FAR/coverage proposals, assembly, or consumer.

findings.finding: Initial density proposal lacked an explicit required-dedication denominator condition. Measurement p26 and corrected O21836 p14 unambiguously require pre-dedication property lines for density/GFA area.
findings.resolution: All 33 density records now retain the exact narrow reference and REQUIRED_DEDICATION as unresolved, without importing the defective adjacent setback sentence.

findings.finding: An initial broad FAR reference to all of 113.0246 risked claiming closure of unrelated disputed setback clauses. A blanket FAR exclusion was considered and rejected after direct source reading: the density/GFA sentence is independently clear.
findings.resolution: All eight FAR proposals limit the reference to the verified opening density/GFA sentence and retain a dedication predicate. Seven height proposals define an envelope form with an unresolved lawful setback input, nine explicit ordinary-context exclusions and fire-official condition; no setback line is selected. The corrected source chain is not claimed for omitted alley remapping or defective dedication/underground setback clauses.

findings.finding: An open-ended artifacts map could omit a required contract artifact.
findings.resolution: Consumer exact SEALED_ARTIFACTS key equality and digest validation passed independent missing-key, empty-map and extra-key attacks. The reviewed source/contract remained unchanged during the attacks.

density_lot_area_conclusions: 21 RS/RX/RT cells retain one dwelling unit per lot, not an area-derived or zone-digit-derived capacity. Single-dwelling definitions exclude ADUs/JADUs.
12 RM cells preserve square feet per dwelling unit, 113.0222(a) threshold and once-only rounding, multi-zone treatment, footnotes1/2 and separate affordable-housing reference. No formula is executed.
RM-5-12 preserves the named-community 1500-square-foot one-dwelling-or-two-guest-room alternative; neither community nor use is selected.
All 33 minimum-lot-area values are development standards, not generic minimum developable-lot claims or the RM density denominator. Legal-lot status and the 113.0237(b) exception remain attached.
RX/RT alley credit preserves half-width, 10-foot and ten-percent bounds solely for minimum lot area; no legal area/density/FAR increase is inferred.

O21836 p11 and O22109 p15 explicitly leave 113.0222(a)-(b) unchanged; O21934 pp4-6 removes fn7 and leaves RS-1-2 minimum lot area20000 outside Coastal. Claimed profile is dated, outside Coastal, new applications, outside Miramar transition; no inside/unknown-Coastal fallback.
other_family_conclusions: 28 RS front/interior-side records retain source values, mandatory narrow-lot formulas separately from optional reallocation, source-specific floors, independent slope/cul-de-sac permissions, measurement scope, fire discretion, and all excluded contexts. Interior-side corner-lot width choice is explicitly outside scope.

Seven height expressions retain both24/30 meanings, inward-from-vertical angle table and inclusive75/150 boundaries. Required setbacks, surveyed width, grade and branch selection remain unresolved. This verifies a formula, not an actual building envelope or all setback law.

Eight direct RS FAR parameters do not depend on defective TableJ. RS1-8..14 retain the up-to400-square-foot shall exclusion, distinct from RT525/may. GFA/dedication measurements remain references/conditions, not floor-area outputs.

Seven RS coverage expressions retain strict steep-hillside fraction>0.5, both gradient/elevation conjunctions,50%parameter, footprint exclusions and non-unrestricted fallback. No slope, area or footprint is calculated.

TableJ punctuation/fractional gaps, RS rear Table141-04D reference, street-side8% reach, RT1-5 front bounds and RM5-12 story/height schedule issues remain excluded; no apparent defect is silently corrected.

review_limits: The accepted unit is the entire qualified record, including reviewed_proposal, scope_details, footnotes and references; discarding these fields would be a new and unapproved consumer.
Source archives are evidence, not approval of every clause appearing on their pages.
Existing97 dimension approvals are preserved under their earlier contract, not reclassified as newly parcel-application-safe.
No public UI, database, parcel capacity, compliance, deployment or program entitlement is approved.
